That helper outputs register to 0x388, polls input 0x388 in fixed 10-iteration and 40-iteration LOOPs, outputs value to 0x389, and returns; each direct call therefore causes two byte OUTs and 50 status INs. memory_state.global_state: No global data mutation and no return value (void far). The input vol value is held in DI for clamp/index use; original code does not overwrite BP+0xa.

constants_widths_pointer_arithmetic.widths_signedness: MSC target int is signed 16-bit. Initial volume additions, clamps, instrument transposition multiply-by-12 and note update are word operations interpreted signed by JNS/JLE/JS/JG. The attenuation multiply is unsigned 16-bit: operands are in 0..63 so product <=3969 and no product truncation changes the value; SHR 6 is logical. Table values and masks are then reduced to the low byte passed to the char helper ABI.
constants_widths_pointer_arithmetic.pointer_math: instr indexes 6-byte Instr records; the far pointer is loaded from member offset +2. p+0x0d and p+0x0b are byte-offset far accesses to signed words; p[2] is an unsigned byte. The volume lookup uses element stride 2 (int table) and the low byte. note%12 and note/12 are evaluated only on the 0..127 signed range, so signed IDIV remainder/quotient equal the C source operations.
constants_widths_pointer_arithmetic.constants: Volume clamps 0 and 0x7f; attenuation uses 0x3f and shift 6, preserving p[2] upper mask 0xc0; note transposition multiplier 12; note bounds 0..0x7f; semitone divisor/table length 12; pitch register bases 0xa0/0xb0 and octave offset 8; operator-volume register base 0x40.

static_axes.algorithm: The source and original both add global and instrument signed-word volume offsets, clamp in order to [0,127], compute the same unsigned 6-bit operator level while retaining instrument bits 7..6, then add instrument semitone transpose*12 and emit pitch registers only for adjusted note 0..127.
static_axes.control_flow: Each of four original branch sites has a source predicate, signed word width, target and fallthrough recorded above. The two volume branches always converge before one volume write; two note branches jointly gate both pitch writes. No missing CFG edge found.
static_axes.calls: Direct helper count/order/condition/arguments match source lines 62-67. Callee boundary and its actual fixed I/O/polling side effects are traced to 283E:0020.
static_axes.memory: All data reads, word/byte widths, far pointer member and offsets, parameter-slot update, frame temporaries, no-global-write fact, and transitive I/O effects are inventoried above.
static_axes.return_abi: Both are void far functions; one epilogue; saved callee-preserved registers restored.
